SourceText:
FUTURE KINGDOMS STUDIO PROUDLY PRESENTS: THE BERBER DYNASTIES.
A mod By hossein81 and marcokistan.

IMPORTANT NOTE: In order to play this mod, in the lobby you need to make sure to apply both the gamemode and the tuning-pack, otherwise it will not work.

------------------------------------------

- THE BERBER DYNASTIES (980-1549 C.E) - (Three Star Difficulty)

Alliance, Nomadic Attraction, Trade

The Berber Dynasties develop from mobile tribal raiders into a trade- and faith-centered Maghrebi state, then finish with resilient infrastructure and specialized gunpowder. Their strength is flexible cavalry and carefully chosen tribal support; their lasting weakness is the absence of standard Men-at-Arms and Crossbowmen.

------------------------------------------

- Nomadic Attraction Gameplay Mechanic

Tribal Tent 

Costs 100 Wood, 100 Stone (Limit: 4, 1 per Age). Projects a 1-tile non-overlapping influence zone. Military resource spending inside influence adds to a counter, when the counter reaches a threshold, you recieve a free villager. 

Tribal Tent Upgrades

Tribal Reforms (Age III): Research at Tribal Tent. Upgrades all tribal units to Age III profile.
Tribal Dynasties (Age IV): Research at Tribal Tent. Upgrades all tribal units to Age IV profile.

- Tribal Alliance Selection (Tribal Tent / Market)

Choose one alliance:

Sanhaja Alliance

+20% Wood drop-off yield.
Unlocks Sanhaja Camel Archer.

Zenata Alliance

+20% Food drop-off yield.
Unlocks Zenata Lancer.

Masmuda Alliance

+20% Gold & Stone drop-off yield.
Unlocks Masmuda Crossbowman.

- A Call from the Minbar

Religious buildings can activate an AOE conversion, when the call from minbar technology is researched.

- A civilization of trade

Berbers get the Tribal Market, a cheaper market that produces the saharan trader and that hosts the alliance units.

CIVILIZATION PASSIVE BONUSES:

Nomadic Trade Network

Town Centers, Markets, drop-off buildings, and Docks cost 10% less Wood.

Enduring Generations

All military and economic units gain:

+5% Max HP in Age II
+10% in Age III
+15% in Age IV (does not affect buildings).

CIVILIZATION UNIQUE UNITS:

Tuareg Spearman, Mehari Rider, Sanhaja Camel Archer, Zenata Lancer, Masmuda Crossbowman, Almohad Handgunner

CIVILIZATION UNIQUE BUILDINGS:

Tribal Tent, Tribal Market

CIVILIZATION UNIQUE ABILITIES:

Raise Shields, Desert Pathfinding, Concussive Shot, Desert Pace, Desert Hunt, Blood Fury, Deploy Shield

CIVILIZATION UNIQUE LANDMARKS:

Ribat of the Sanhaja, Funduq of Sijilmasa, Mosque of Tlemcen, Dar al-Jihad of Marrakech, Madrasa of Fez, Almohad Grand Keep

CIVILIZATION UNIQUE TECHNOLOGIES: 

Desert Pathfinding, call from the minbar, Tribal Reforms, Tribal Dynasties

------------------------------------------

From Future Kingdoms, both Hossein and marcokistan hope you will enjoy our mod.

marcokistan (lead developer)
Karyu (media)
lammet (media)
ForsakenCryz (honorable mention for giving the idea of making the berber civilization to the studio and leading the start of its development, after the rework, he became the civilization QA tester)

Future Kingdoms 2026

SourceText: Training units in buildings within a Tent's 1-tile influence adds their actual paid resource cost to that Tent's counter. Thresholds are 500, 700, 900, and so on.
